commit.message:
8381379: Align metazone selection with JDK 17

Select the current metazone by comparing the usesMetazone from/to range
with the JDK build time, as JDK-8251317 does in JDK 17+, instead of
taking the entry without a "to" attribute. The build tools compile with
-source 7 against the boot JDK, so java.util.Date/SimpleDateFormat are
used in place of java.time.

Also reset tzid/metazone per <timezone> element and skip zones with no
current metazone instead of failing, as JDK-8181157 does in JDK 17+.
Without this a zone with no current mapping inherited the previous
zone's metazone.
